top_signals.title: Failed CDL exams, $3,000 payments and Bluetooth cheating scheme lead to federal charges
top_signals.summary:
A Massachusetts man faces up to 15 years in prison after investigators linked his commercial driving exams to a Bluetooth cheating operation. Phone records and an undercover investigation exposed how the $3,000 scheme worked.

top_signals.title: Stephen Roach: Xi May Be Using Trump Summits to Buy Time
top_signals.summary: Stephen Roach argues Xi Jinping’s willingness to engage in a series of meetings with Donald Trump may reflect concern about China’s economy and a desire to buy time. Roach suggests Xi may not share the personal camaraderie Trump portrays and says Chinese officials are likely realistic about how much progress is possible with an unpredictable counterpart. (Source: Bloomberg)
